skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles of information systems analysis and design, including logical and physical design, database design, algorithm design, and user interface design.
Manage and oversee the development, operation, and maintenance of information systems projects.
Identify and solve problems in information systems management, including feasibility analysis and project planning.
Analyze real-world business problems and recommend appropriate information systems solutions.
Work independently and collaboratively in group settings, demonstrating leadership and responsibility.
Effectively communicate information systems concepts and solutions to stakeholders.
Adhere to professional ethics in the field of information systems management.
Understand and apply the phases of the system development life cycle, including requirements gathering, analysis, design, implementation, and maintenance.
Manage and design databases for information systems.
Develop software solutions for information systems using tools like MS Project, Draw.io, and Figma.
Manage information technology projects and systems, including planning, monitoring, and evaluating.
Analyze business processes and recommend information systems solutions.
Lead and manage teams in information systems projects.
Make informed decisions regarding the selection and implementation of information systems.
Write technical reports and documentation for information systems projects.
Manage time effectively to meet project deadlines and deliverables.
Present information systems solutions and project outcomes effectively.
